property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer always attempts the external calls and thus will revert if any called counterparty reverts; the mutant that returns early breaks this by never performing the calls so it cannot revert for those inputs.
change_summary: Insert an early unconditional return true immediately after the require, causing function to return true without performing any calls (observable difference when original would do work but still return true — still different behavior for side-effects, but returns remain true; however this mutant changes when calls are executed and thus may return different values if later modified — INCLUDED because it changes observable external behavior by skipping calls).
